name: button

frames.best_why: All six variants sit in one even row with every label readable and no cursor covering them.

tagline: Six clickable action styles in a row, from solid white to bare link.
summary: A matching set of action controls in six looks: a light filled primary, a dark secondary, an outlined one, a ghost with no fill, a red destructive and a plain text link, all sharing one rounded rectangle and small medium text.
appearance: A single row of six short rounded controls on black. The first is filled light with dark text, the second dark grey, the third clear with a thin border, the fourth pure text, the fifth salmon red and the last a bare text link.
behaviour: Static: no press or hover effect is caught in the frames. In the code each variant darkens its fill on hover, the link one underlines, and keyboard focus draws a soft ring.
demo_content: Six controls labelled Button, Secondary, Outline, Ghost, Destructive and Link.
search_phrases: clickable action with a filled background
primary and secondary actions in a row
text link styled as an action
ghost style action with no fill
rounded click target with a label
outlined action next to a solid one
use_when: You need a small set of matching action styles that share one shape and sizing scale.
avoid_when: Colours come from theme tokens, so the exact look shifts with the host app's palette.
customise: The label is children, variant picks one of six looks, size picks one of four heights, and asChild renders a link instead. Any native attribute passes through.
weight_why: A styled native control with colour and shadow transitions only.

a11y.note: It is a real native control with visible text and a focus ring; reduced motion is not handled, but only colour shifts animate.

issues: No frame shows a hover or pressed state, so the variants are only seen as static fills
Ghost and Link look almost the same on the black stage
polish_why: Even, consistent variants; ghost and link are hard to tell apart on the dark stage.
